name: Identity & Career Status
purpose: Verify who the candidate is and capture current employment availability.

sections.title: Verify Your Identity & Resume
sections.desc: Your Aadhaar is verified instantly with DigiLocker - no Aadhaar or PAN upload is needed. The number is stored masked (last 4 characters only). Upload your updated resume here, or create one later in Stage 7.

slots.label: Updated Resume
slots.hint: Optional - or create one in Stage 7

sections.title: Personal & Contact
sections.desc: Auto-extracted from resume / ID wherever available.

fields.label: Registered Mobile Number
fields.placeholder: Mobile linked with ID for OTP

name: Education, Training & Foundation
purpose: Capture academic base and how the candidate entered the RCM / healthcare career.

sections.title: Education
sections.desc: Can be extracted from resume and confirmed.

fields.label: College Name
options: PSG College of Arts and Science

sections.title: Academy / Training (optional)
sections.desc: Training is optional - many people enter RCM through campus placements, college drives, referrals, self-study or on-the-job learning. Choose the option that fits you; only choose "Yes" if you want to add academy details.

fields.label: How did you learn / get trained for your role?

sections.title: Training / Academy History
sections.desc: Allow multiple training entries.

name: Employment Timeline
purpose: Build a company-wise verified employment timeline and calculate total experience automatically.

sections.title: Employment Documents
sections.desc: Use offer letters, experience letters, relieving letters and payslips to prefill employment records.

sections.title: Current Career Status
sections.desc: These are current intent/status fields and should be candidate-confirmed.

fields.label: Do you have a Notice Period?

sections.title: Current / Previous Employment Entry
sections.desc: Add one company at a time. Duration should be auto-calculated.

fields.label: Domain / Process Handled
fields.placeholder: e.g., Medical Coding, Inpatient DRG, Denial Management, AR Calling

fields.label: Software / Tools Used in this Company
fields.placeholder: e.g., Epic, 3M Encoder (type several, separated by commas)

fields.label: Reason for Career Gap
fields.placeholder: e.g., Higher studies, Family reasons, Medical, Relocation

sections.title: Total Experience
sections.desc: Calculated automatically from your employment dates, not manually typed.

name: RCM Domain & Technical Expertise
purpose: Capture what the candidate actually does inside RCM, by process, specialty and tools.

sections.title: Domain & Process Experience
sections.desc: Select all applicable areas.

sections.title: Technical Expertise
sections.desc: Structured fields for recruiter filtering. Fill the details separately for your Primary domain and your Secondary domain.

fields.label: Previous / Current Domain
fields.placeholder: e.g., Current: Medical Coding, Previous: AR / Billing

fields.label: Previous / Current Domain (Secondary)
fields.placeholder: e.g., Current: Medical Coding, Previous: AR / Billing

name: Performance, Leadership & Achievements
purpose: Capture how well the candidate performs, not only where they worked.

sections.title: Share Performance Details?
sections.desc: Optional. Choose Not Available or Skip if you prefer not to share, or the details are unclear.

fields.label: Do you want to share performance details?

sections.title: Performance Metrics (company / project-wise)
sections.desc: Add the performance and productivity for each company or project. Use "Add Another Company / Project" to record more than one.

fields.label: Company
fields.placeholder: Pick from your Stage 3 companies or type

fields.label: Daily Productivity
fields.placeholder: Charts / Claims / Accounts / Calls per day

sections.title: Leadership & Achievements
sections.desc: Capture career progression and leadership exposure.

fields.label: Awards & Recognition
fields.placeholder: Employee of month, quality award, etc.

name: Certifications & Professional Credentials
purpose: Capture and verify professional certifications and continuing credentials.

sections.title: Add Certification
sections.desc: Each certification should be stored as a separate credential card.

fields.label: Certification Name
fields.placeholder: CPC / CIC / CCS / CRC / CPB / etc.

sections.title: CEU / Continuing Education
sections.desc: Optional professional maintenance tracking.

name: Career Documents & Future Preferences
purpose: Store career evidence and capture what the candidate wants next.

sections.title: Resume
sections.desc: Upload your existing resume, or create a new one from the details you already entered.

sections.title: Create a New Resume
sections.desc: Built from your earlier stages - preview, edit and save.

sections.title: Future Career Preferences
sections.desc: Used for job matching and career recommendations.

name: Talentera Career Passport & Review
purpose: Review the complete experienced profile before publishing it to recruiters.

sections.title: Profile Review
sections.desc: Candidate reviews extracted, declared and verified information before publishing.

sections.title: Visibility & Consent
sections.desc: Control how the professional profile is shown to companies.

sections.title: Final Actions
sections.desc: Publish the Career Passport after review.
